notes.title: Fishbowl Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for playing the Fishbowl Demo and giving your feedback! Based on your messages we've made some updates to the demo, here are the patch notes:

🌱 Features

 Hint for Unpacking puzzle
 Improve control scheme


🐞 Bugs

 Remove double knocking SFX
 Fix soft-lock on fridge, shower and desk
 FIx typos


We're still looking at the scaling issue that some of you have reported and also more features that have been requested. Being a two-person team we can't commit to timelines yet, but are grateful for all the feedback we've received so far.

If you have any other feedback please do email us, or leave a comment here.



Love,
Rhea & Prateek
💜 imissmyfriends.studio
